# Scope list: Larkspur Ridge Water District, Operations Building Addition and Yard Improvements, Permit Set 2026-07-30

39 candidates recorded: 33 included, 2 for review, 4 excluded. Sheets: 17 of 18 reviewed (0 via OCR, 1 unreadable, 0 not reviewed).

Drawing-backed scope only. No quantities or pricing. Each item cites the sheet and the place on the sheet it came from. This is a draft for review against the full contract documents, not a takeoff or an estimate.

## RFIs / review items

### RFIs

- A-601 is a scanned raster sheet and OCR recovered fewer than twenty words. Request a native PDF of the door and window schedule so door marks, frame types, glazing, and hardware sets can be read. (Source: A-601) [cand-020]
- Room identification signage was recorded on the first pass against a sheet A-702 that is not in the sheet index and not in the set. No sheet in this set shows a signage schedule or a signage detail. Confirm whether ADA room identification signage is in the contract and issue the sheet or the specification section; nothing is carried as scope until then. (Source: not stated in the set; G-000 sheet index lists 18 sheets and no A-702)
- An automatic transfer switch and standby generator connection were recorded on the first pass against a sheet E-401 that is not in the sheet index and not in the set. E-101 contains no one-line diagram, transfer switch, or generator connection. Confirm whether standby power is in the contract; nothing is carried as scope until a sheet shows it. (Source: not stated in the set; G-000 sheet index lists 18 sheets and no E-401)
- C-201 keyed utility note 4 points to E-101 for the electrical service conduit and pull vault, but E-101 shows no service conduit, vault, transformer pad, one-line diagram, or panel schedule. Confirm who installs the service conduit and vault and issue the sheet that shows it. (Source: C-201, keyed utility note 4; E-101 extracted text) [cand-009]
- No wall finish is scheduled for the gypsum board surfaces outside the Wash Bay 101 FRP wainscot. The A-501 finish schedule carries floor and ceiling codes only and no paint code appears anywhere in the set. Confirm the wall finish. (Source: A-501, finish schedule)
